screenshots.name: admin-dashboard
screenshots.description: Administration dashboard - the main landing page showing the reception page with recent receipts table, action buttons (Import from RS, Create Receipt), and administration sidebar navigation visible

mustContain: administration page with table and action buttons

screenshots.validationNote: EN identical to admin-navigation/admin-reception-menu/admin-reception-page. KA shows general Dashboard (not admin). RU shows general Dashboard (not admin). All need recapture to show unique admin dashboard content.

screenshots.name: admin-navigation
screenshots.description: Administration sidebar navigation menu showing all administration sub-sections expanded - Reception, Transfer, Order, and Balances menu items visible in the left sidebar

captureSteps.script: (() => { const sidebar = document.querySelector('nav, [role="navigation"], [class*="sidebar"]'); if (sidebar) { return 'sidebar found: ' + sidebar.className.substring(0, 60); } return 'no sidebar found'; })()

mustContain: sidebar navigation with administration menu items

screenshots.validationNote: EN identical to admin-dashboard (needs distinct sidebar-focused view). KA identical to admin-reception-menu-ka. RU shows admin reception page with Russian nav bar - acceptable but identical to reception-menu-ru.

screenshots.name: admin-reception-menu
screenshots.description: Reception sub-menu in the administration sidebar navigation showing Reception-related links (Reception, Receptions List, Reception Group) highlighted or expanded

captureSteps.script: (() => { const items = document.querySelectorAll('nav a, [role="navigation"] a, [class*="sidebar"] a'); return 'nav links: ' + items.length; })()

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages are duplicates of other screenshots (EN=dashboard, KA=navigation-ka, RU=navigation-ru/reception-page-ru). Needs to show distinct reception menu highlight.

screenshots.name: admin-transfer-menu
screenshots.description: Transfer sub-menu in the administration sidebar navigation showing Transfer-related links (Transfer Confirmation, Transfer, Transfers, Transfer Group) highlighted or expanded
screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show distinct transfer-related pages. EN shows Transfer Confirmation with filters. KA/RU show Transfer create page. All unique from other basenames.

screenshots.name: admin-order-menu
screenshots.description: Order sub-menu in the administration sidebar navigation showing Order-related links (Order Confirmation, Order, Orders, Order Group) highlighted or expanded
screenshots.validationNote: EN shows Order Confirmation page (unique). KA identical to admin-order-page-ka (needs distinct capture). RU shows Order page with Russian nav (unique from en). Some untranslated 'shekveta.*' translation keys visible.

screenshots.name: admin-balances-menu
screenshots.description: Balances sub-menu in the administration sidebar navigation showing the Balances link highlighted, navigated to the balances page

mustContain: balances navigation item highlighted in sidebar

screenshots.validationNote: All 3 languages show Balances page with inventory table. Unique from other basenames. PASS.
